statements.t: We’ve reported data across both programs throughout 2026, and we look forward to closing out a data-rich year with additional ITP data at ASH in December.
Looking ahead, we are poised to enter 2027 with two promising programs, multiple anticipated data readouts across both, and the potential to initiate pivotal studies.”
Following positive single-dose data for the SC formulation in May 2026, the Company plans to initiate SC study in autoimmune disease patients.
Based on its current operating plan, the Company expects this balance to fund operations into the second half of 2028.
